note: GFP recreation area 14 mi northwest of Miller on 191st St. Two campgrounds on Lake Louise: the wooded Main Campground on the lake's southeast arm (electric sites 1E-31E, 2 camping cabins, comfort station, boat dock and fish cleaning station) and the primitive West Campground on a wooded peninsula (8 non-electric sites, vault toilet, archery range). A day-use area with a sandy beach lies between. --Claude
